about: Québec is the capital of the province of Québec, on the north shore of the St. Lawrence River. The old fortified city is a UNESCO World Heritage site and a centre of French-language government and culture. Newer boroughs spread along the river and inland from Cap Diamant. About 550,000 people live in the city.
